purpose: Create a neutral 2026 year-to-date raw-data package for ChatGPT-led pattern discovery. The app must not choose, score or backtest a preferred predictor.

source_event_definition.market: Binance Spot canonical quote preference USDT, USDC, FDUSD
source_event_definition.outcome: saleable low-to-later-high rise of at least 50 percent within 480 minutes
source_event_definition.saleability: at least 500 quote units of seller-initiated executed notional within 300 seconds after the exact crossing trade

integrity_note: Parts of 2026 were examined in earlier research rounds. Therefore the whole 2026 export is discovery-only and must not be represented as untouched validation or sealed evidence.

sample_design.control_baseline: latest minimum low in the 479 completed minutes before the pseudo-cross minute, identical to the scanner
control_rejection: selected low rises by 50 percent within the following 480 minutes
pseudo-cross or selected low lies within 24 hours of a known same-symbol event
duplicate control baseline already used by another matched group
sample_design.duration_matching: same <=3h, 3-6h, 6-7h or 7-8h band as the event

partitioning.future_requirement: Collect separate earlier periods after ChatGPT freezes candidate rules and acceptance criteria.

app_prohibitions: no profit target or stop loss
